text: Find something with a spiral in it
hint: A snail shell, a curled fern, or a garden hose counts.

text: Photograph three different leaf shapes together
hint: Gather three distinct leaves and photograph them side by side.

text: Photo of the longest shadow you can find
hint: Wait for the sun to be low and find a long shadow of a tree, building, or yourself.

text: Find a mushroom or fungi
hint: Look near the roots of trees or in damp grassy areas.

text: Photograph a smooth, round rock
hint: Look in riverbeds, pathways, or gardens.

text: Capture the texture of tree bark
hint: Get up close to a tree trunk.

text: Find a yellow flower
hint: Any flower with yellow petals counts.

text: Photograph a bird in flight or on a branch
hint: Look up at the trees or sky.

text: Find a spider web
hint: Look in corners of fences, bushes, or trees, especially in the morning.

text: Capture a cloud that looks like an animal
hint: Look up and use your imagination.

text: Photograph a patch of moss
hint: Look on the north side of trees or on damp rocks/walls.

text: Find a fallen acorn or pinecone
hint: Look under oak or pine trees.

text: Photograph a puddle reflecting the sky
hint: Look for still water after rain.

text: Find a bug or insect
hint: Look closely at leaves, flowers, or the ground.

text: Photograph a feather
hint: Keep your eyes on the ground in parks or near trees.

text: Find something completely red
hint: A bright red autumn leaf, berry, or flower.

text: Photograph dew drops on grass or leaves
hint: Best found in the early morning.

text: Find a trail made by an animal or insect
hint: Look for paw prints, ant trails, or snail trails.

text: Photograph a piece of driftwood or aged wood
hint: Look near water or in old forests.

text: Find a seed pod or dandelion ready to blow
hint: Look in open fields or gardens.

text: Photograph a patch of bare earth or sand
hint: Find a spot without grass or pavement.

text: Find a Y-shaped branch or twig
hint: Look on the ground under trees.

text: Photograph the sky at sunset or sunrise
hint: Look for colors other than blue or grey.

text: Find a plant growing through a crack in the pavement
hint: Look along sidewalks or driveways.

text: Photograph a natural arch or bridge
hint: Can be branches forming an arch or a rock formation.

text: Find a berry on a bush
hint: Look for wild berries, but don't eat them.

text: Photograph a shadow that looks like a face
hint: Look at the shadows of trees or objects.

text: Find a heart-shaped rock or leaf
hint: Look closely at the shapes around you.

text: Photograph a flock of birds
hint: Look for multiple birds flying or gathering together.

text: Find a single blade of grass standing taller than the rest
hint: Look closely at a lawn or field.
